Growth and Reach

Since its founding in 2018, The Candler Foundry has grown from the ground up, extending Candler’s scholarship through courses, media, and shared learning experiences that now reach thousands of participants.

Our Journey
Eight Years of Growing Impact
2018
The Candler Foundry established at Emory University
2020
Online courses launched; first Candler in Conversation podcast
2022
500th participant milestone reached
2024
2,000th participant milestone; TheoEd expands to 8 cities
2025
On-Demand courses and Sunday School Simplified launched

Connecting Candler’s scholarship to the wider world

Through courses, media, and practical resources, The Candler Foundry translates rigorous theological scholarship into learning that shapes congregations, leaders, and everyday faith.

Extending Candler into communities

Bringing Candler’s faculty, alumni, and scholarship into churches, classrooms, and homes around the world.

Equipping leaders and learners for everyday ministry

Practical tools shaped by Candler’s scholarship to support teaching, preaching, and spiritual formation in real contexts.

Engaging the wider public in theological conversation

Creating accessible entry points for spiritual seekers and curious audiences to explore faith, meaning, and theology.

The Candler Foundry

Our Team

The people who make The Candler Foundry possible

TheoEd brings the world's leading theological thinkers to cities across the U.S. TheoEd is open to the public, livestreamed, and made available for free online, becoming a surprising way for all spiritual seekers - churched and unchurched alike - to truly engage in theological discussion.
